name: Stage 27:1: Stora Djulö to Etapp 27
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 27:1, Stora Djulö to Etapp 27.
utilities: Short access connector from Stora Djulö toward stage 27, useful mainly for Katrineholm/Stora Djulö access rather than as a wilderness hike.

Current Sörmlandsleden text says the connector joins stage 27 at/near the road 52 and 55/56 roundabout area; Glysas grav is a nearby heritage POI and older endpoint reference, not the canonical current endpoint.

Stora Djulö/Djulöbadet is the strong service cluster: parking, STF hostel, manor/cafe, museum/recreation area, paid camping, beach, toilets and seasonal/customer-dependent food. Many food/museum services are summer-season or opening-hours dependent.
Public transport should be checked live with Sörmlandstrafiken. Useful nearby stop contexts include Djulöbadet, Svartbäcksvägen, Djulö kvarn and Glysas grav, but route numbers differ between sources.
Katrineholm Central is the main rail access point for the connector; it is useful trip context but sits well away from both route endpoints, so use bus, bike, taxi or a road walk from town.
waterSources: No reliable public drinking-water point is listed on stage 27:1 itself. Carry water from Katrineholm/Stora Djulö or use customer/service refills at STF, Stora Djulö cafe or Djulö Camping when available.
Djulösjön lake water is natural/untested and should be treated if used. Stage 27 springs are beyond the connector and should not be presented as 27:1 water points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 4 km; Naturkartan and the 2025 Sörmlandsleden long-distance passport list 4.5 km, AllTrails reports 2.5 mi, OSM relation 9632259 is tagged 4 km but can measure about 4.3 km depending on members, and the local official-GPX-derived line is about 3.8 km.

Route character: easy access/transport walk through Stora Djulö recreation area, hostel/manor/museum context, Djulö allé, asphalt/residential edge, Gatstuberg/Skogskapellet, a hilltop shelter/bench viewpoint over Djulösjön, then road/forest connector toward the stage-27 road 52/55-56 join. Team Vildmark's November report described long asphalt and road-parallel stretches with traffic noise rather than a destination wilderness feel.

Older Naturkartan, OSM/Pacer-style listings and some blogs still say Glysas grav; use the current official page for endpoint wording. Old reports around the road-52 crossing mention confusing signs/fencing near the former Glysas grav alignment, so follow current orange waymarks rather than stale map text.

Geometry caveat: Naturkartan site 5083 line starts near 58.972249, 16.208894 and ends near 58.970988, 16.263086, while OSM relation 9632259 shares the current Stage 27 join node near 58.970568, 16.264670. Naturkartan's 27:1 line stops roughly 100 m short of the Stage 27 line and OSM has a small component gap near the Skogskapellet/forest turn; treat both as source-geometry caveats, not intentional route gaps.
Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass.
The hilltop shelter/benches are confirmed by official/community sources, but no reliable exact coordinate was found. Treat the pin as approximate and do not assume overnight-shelter quality.

No marked free tent site was verified on this connector. Katrineholm local rules put camping inside Djulö fritidsområde at the formal camping site only; do not present the Stora Djulö/Djulöbadet public recreation cluster as free tenting.

Use prepared fire/grill places only where present, and check current Katrineholm/VSR fire risk before lighting anything. At the 2026-04-27 check VSR had no formal Katrineholm/Vingåker ban but still warned of high fire risk; the Djulö grill place has no verified woodshed or wood supply.

Djulöbadet/Naturkartan and Katrineholm local rules restrict smoking and dogs at ordinary municipal bathing places; use the designated dog bathing area and current signs. Katrineholm also requires dogs on public places to be leashed, and national 1 March-20 August wildlife rules still apply.

Djulösjön fishing normally requires a fishing permit except for specific simple pole-fishing allowances in local material. Verify current permits locally before fishing or relying on Djulö Camping/card-sales information.
No verified Stage 27:1 bin/waste point was found during the 2026-04-27 pass. Carry out waste unless a staffed service explicitly accepts it.

facilities.name: Stora Djulö stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start near Stora Djulö recreation area. Parking is listed at/near the start; OSM parking is slightly west, so check local signs.

facilities.name: Stora Djulö parking
facilities.description: Mapped parking near the Stora Djulö/Djulöbadet access area; useful for the connector but local signs/capacity should be checked.

facilities.name: STF Katrineholm Stora Djulö Vandrarhem
facilities.description: Hostel near the trail with guest kitchen, shared showers, high-season breakfast context, limited pet rooms, Wi-Fi, canoe rental and phone-managed reception. Book/verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Stora Djulö manor cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/restaurant/ice cream context in the manor/recreation area. 2026 cafe information listed reopening 29 April and ice-cream cafe 14 May; verify current opening before relying on a meal.

facilities.name: Stora Djulö hembygdsmuseum context
facilities.description: Official stage text passes the local-history museum and Stora Djulö manor area. Local-history sources list Wermbolsstugan, garveri, new museum, stable museum, carriage/machine museum, smithy and carpentry workshop; treat opening as seasonal/event-dependent.

facilities.name: Djulö Camping
facilities.description: Paid camping/cabins/motorhome/service-house option near the stage start, with toilets/showers, cafe/kiosk and activities according to camping and municipal sources. Use for planned camping rather than assuming free tenting on the connector.

facilities.name: Djulö Camping customer toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet at/near Djulö Camping. Treat as customer/service-house access rather than all-hours public toilet.

facilities.name: Djulöbadet toilets
facilities.description: Public/nearby toilet context at Djulöbadet/camping area, not a mid-trail toilet. Availability may be seasonal or tied to facilities.

facilities.name: Djulöbadet east toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet in the Djulöbadet beach area; availability may be seasonal and should be checked on arrival.

facilities.name: Djulöbadet / Djulösjön bathing
facilities.description: Municipal/EU bathing place near the start with sandy beach, grass area, jetties including accessible ramp, nearby toilet, changing-room/bin/table/playground/sports context, parking, public transport and seasonal service. 2025-08-05 sample was tjänligt with no algal bloom; check current bathing status and local rules.

facilities.name: Hundbad vid Djulö
facilities.description: Separate dog-bathing option at the Djulö boat-harbour area. Dogs are not allowed at ordinary municipal bathing places; follow current signs.

facilities.name: Grillplats Djulö
facilities.description: Simple municipal grill/fireplace in the Djulöbadet area near parking and toilets. Naturkartan lists no woodshed/wood supply, so bring fuel only if fires are currently allowed.

facilities.name: Djulöstigen shelter/grill context
facilities.description: Nearby Djulöstigen recreation-loop context with a shelter and grill place along Djulösjön's western shore. Useful start-area context only; do not merge the Djulöstigen loop into Stage 27:1 route geometry.

facilities.name: Djulö 4H-gård
facilities.description: Seasonal 4H farm near Djulö allé; 4H sources list summer-week animal visits/opening windows. Treat as a seasonal family stop, not a trail service guarantee.

facilities.name: Djulöbadet bus context
facilities.description: Nearby Sörmlandstrafiken stop context for the Stora Djulö/Djulöbadet area; third-party sources show city-bus context, but verify live routes and times.

facilities.name: Djulö kvarn bus context
facilities.description: Nearby Sörmlandstrafiken stop west of the Stora Djulö service cluster; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Svartbäcksvägen bus context
facilities.description: STF access context: sources describe bus from Katrineholm/Stadsparken to Svartbäcksvägen then about 1 km walk to the hostel. Route numbers vary; verify live.

facilities.name: Skogskapellet
facilities.description: Stage passes Skogskapellet before turning into the forest toward the hilltop viewpoint/shelter. Official text notes it was inaugurated in 1980; attraction context only.

facilities.name: Gatstuberg hill shelter and viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate hilltop rest shelter/benches with view over Djulösjön after Skogskapellet. Confirmed in official/community text, but exact pin and overnight suitability are not verified.

facilities.name: Glysas grav heritage marker
facilities.description: Large ship-setting heritage point near the route area. Older sources call this the endpoint, but current official text says the connector now joins stage 27 at the road 52/55-56 roundabout area.

facilities.name: Glysas grav bus context
facilities.description: Nearby Sörmlandstrafiken stop context for Glysas grav/Skirtorpssjön access. Verify current departures and do not treat the heritage marker as the current connector endpoint.

facilities.name: Current stage 27 route join
facilities.description: Current route-builder join to Stage 27 on the drawn line. The official text continues toward the road 52/55-56 roundabout; Glysas grav is only nearby/older endpoint context.

facilities.name: Road 52 / 55-56 roundabout context
facilities.description: Roundabout/road-continuation context from current official wording. This is not parking and not the old Glysas grav endpoint; use the nearby route-join marker for route-building.

facilities.name: Old Glysas grav alignment warning
facilities.description: Older maps/reports may point toward Glysas grav or describe fencing/confusing signs near the road-52 crossing. Follow current Sörmlandsleden waymarks and the present road 52/55-56 join instead of stale endpoint text.

facilities.name: No verified public tap on Stage 27:1
facilities.description: No public drinking-water tap or fountain was verified on the connector. Use customer/service refills at STF, cafe or camping when open, or carry water from Katrineholm.

facilities.name: No verified Stage 27:1 bins
facilities.description: No reliable public waste/bin point was verified for the connector during the 2026-04-27 pass. Carry out waste unless a staffed service explicitly accepts it.

facilities.name: Stage 27:1 map-source gap caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 9632259 has a small split near the Skogskapellet/forest turn and Naturkartan 27:1 stops short of the Stage 27 line. Treat as source-data caveats, not intentional route-builder gaps.

facilities.name: Djulöbadet bathing rules
facilities.description: Naturkartan/municipal rules restrict smoking and dogs at ordinary municipal bathing places. Use the designated dog bathing place and current local signs.

facilities.name: Djulö wetland works caveat
facilities.description: Katrineholm's Djulö wetland project is planned through 2026 and includes work around the stormwater tunnel toward Djulösjön. Check current municipal traffic/project information before arrival.

facilities.name: Djulö Trafikverket rest area
facilities.description: Nearby off-route road rest area on RV55 with toilet, accessibility, waste and picnic context in road-rest-area listings. Useful by car only; do not present as an on-trail facility.
